title: Retire the catalog secrets and the WAV audio branch
acceptance: NEON_DATABASE_URL, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN are removed from the Cloudflare production Worker.
Production still serves catalog.json and recitation after removal.
The rise/audio-assets branch is retired once nothing builds from it.
The inert rise-chatgpt-demo Worker (no public targets, MCP gates off) is deleted from the Cloudflare account.

evidence.note: The PR names both follow-ups as owner steps after release.
Wrangler could not delete the demo Worker without a broader token scope; it was redeployed with no targets.

wrangler secret delete (x3) --name rise-production; wrangler delete rise-chatgpt-demo; git push origin --delete rise/audio-assets. Before and after each removal: /content/catalog.json 200 (22,203 bytes), /audio/recitation/af_heart/10-1237qhv.opus 200, /release.txt 200, / 200. wrangler secret list now shows only OPENROUTER_API_KEY (docs/USER-OWNED-AI.md step 3; all six retired routes answer 410). The demo Worker lookup returns code 10007.

summary: Done 2026-10-07. NEON_DATABASE_URL, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN are removed from the production Worker (rise-production); no Worker module read them, and catalog.json, a recitation clip, release.txt and Home answered the same before and after. The inert rise-chatgpt-demo Worker is deleted. The rise/audio-assets branch, a stale pointer at #211 already in main, is deleted; recitation hydrates from rise/audio-assets-opus.

activity.summary: Recorded from repository and CI evidence after integration.
Added the inert demo Worker to the cleanup
Secrets removed, demo Worker deleted, old audio branch retired
